verses.english: Numbered Discourses 9.22
3. Abodes of Sentient Beings
A Wild Colt

verses.pali: “Tayo ca, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅke desessāmi tayo ca purisakhaḷuṅke tayo ca assaparasse tayo ca purisaparasse tayo ca bhadde assājānīye tayo ca bhadde purisājānīye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you about three wild colts and three wild people; three excellent horses and three excellent people; and three fine thoroughbred horses and three fine thoroughbred people.
Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.
And what are the three wild colts?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: One wild colt is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: Another wild colt is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: While another wild colt is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.
These are the three wild colts.
And what are the three wild people?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: One wild person is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: Another wild person is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: While another wild person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
verses.english: And how is a wild person fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti, ‘ayaṁ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti, ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti, ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant truly understands: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.
This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho saṁsādeti, no vissajjeti.
verses.english: But when asked a question about the teaching or training, they falter without answering.
This is how they’re not beautiful, I say.
And they don’t receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
This is how they’re not well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: This is how a wild person is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
verses.english: And how is a wild person fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: They truly understand: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.
This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.
This is how they’re beautiful, I say.
But they don’t receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
This is how they’re not well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: This is how a wild person is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
verses.english: And how is a wild person fast, beautiful, and well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: They truly understand: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.
This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.
This is how they’re beautiful, I say.
They receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
This is how they’re well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisakhaḷuṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: This is how a wild person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.
These are the three wild people.
And what are the three excellent horses?
One excellent horse …

verses.pali: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.
These are the three excellent horses.
What are the three excellent people?
One excellent person …

verses.pali: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.
And how is an excellent person …

verses.pali: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
verses.english: fast, beautiful, and well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṁ orambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant, with the ending of the five lower fetters, is reborn spontaneously. They’re extinguished there, and are not liable to return from that world.
This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.
This is how they’re beautiful, I say.
They receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
This is how they’re well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: This is how an excellent person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.
These are the three excellent people.

verses.pali: Katame ca, bhikkhave, tayo bhaddā assājānīyā?
verses.english: And what are the three fine thoroughbred horses?
One fine thoroughbred horse …

verses.pali: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo bhaddā assājānīyā.
verses.english: These are the three fine thoroughbred horses.

verses.pali: Katame ca, bhikkhave, tayo bhaddā purisājānīyā?
verses.english: And what are the three fine thoroughbred people?
One fine thoroughbred person …

verses.pali: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.
And how is a fine thoroughbred person …

verses.pali: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
verses.english: fast, beautiful, and well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āsavānaṁ khayā anāsavaṁ cetovimuttiṁ paññāvimuttiṁ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: It’s a mendicant who realizes the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life. And they live having realized it with their own insight due to the ending of defilements.
This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.
This is how they’re beautiful, I say.
They receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
This is how they’re well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhaddo purisājānīyo javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: This is how a fine thoroughbred person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo bhaddā purisājānīyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the three fine thoroughbred people.”
